course.title: Operations Management
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: A text book publishing company has complied data on total annual sales of its business 15 texts for the preceding nine years:
i) Using an appropriate model, forecast textbook sales for each of the next five years.
ii) Prepare a control chart for the forecast using the original data. Use 2s limits.
iii) Suppose actual sales for the next five years turn out as follows: Years: 10 11 12 13 14 Sales (000): 77.2 82.1 87.8 90.6 98.9 Is the forecast performing adequately? Explain.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2016
